oracle.statement: leg A: describe of a collection created with explicit legal overrides (shard_number=1, replication_factor=1, write_consistency_factor=1, on_disk_payload=false, hnsw m=32/ef_construct=128, indexing_threshold=20000, wal_capacity_mb=64) returns 200 and echoes each value with strict equality at its response_shape grid path - any missing/null/different value (silent reset to default or silent drop) = Type4_StateLogicViolation (returned config is not the collection's resolved config); non-200 on the existing collection = Type1_IllegalRejection; leg B control prints minimal-sibling defaults as observed notes only (no default-dependent oracle); create rejection of an override body = skip-with-note (create lane, G3); 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3; setup failures = SCRIPT_ERROR
